title: My game project is finally making progress

posts.author: oftens
posts.body:
To be honest, game production is much harder than I expected, especially in the first year after I joined my own company, I hardly had much free time to study my game.
But now the game has finally made good progress. Now the main content of the game, including the script, plot and small branches, has been written.
In fact, the most uncomfortable thing for me in the whole game is that I have to overturn my old project after it was not well evaluated by many of my friends. For this reason, I started my project again and made a big update to my story and mechanism.
In addition, during the actual production and testing, I had to make some changes that were inconsistent with the original content according to the actual performance of the game to make the game smoother.
I must admit that my project production is indeed troublesome, but now I have roughly prepared the content of my prologue and the first chapter. After making it, I feel that everything I have paid is worth it.
I hope that my game production can continue to go smoothly. When it is perfected, I will post the DEMO content (prologue and first chapter content) to the forum and Itch, I hope you will like it!
Below is the name and title of my game in English and Japanese. I hope that just by seeing the title you will be interested in learning about my game
